pre_repair_gate.root_cause: Packed c>N bypassed chain_compact_peer_wave32 and used the decode-order segmented fallback. FP16 state was loaded/stored globally and rounded every prompt token, unlike the c1 production recurrence that keeps FP32 state in registers and converts only at chunk boundaries.

repair.mechanism: Registered compact normalized-segments wave32-XOR siblings for FP32 and FP16 state; one wave32 owns each indexed value column, holds four state rows/lane in FP32 registers across the segment, and stores to the declared state dtype only at the packed chunk boundary.
repair.red: FP32 and FP16-state two-segment indexed fixtures match independent host compact-peer replay at rtol/atol=1e-3; focused GDN/routing bundle 71 passed; real Qwen3.8 c2 packed-vs-scalar prefill+decode passes with and without FP16 state.

dirty_screen.protocol: Actual p512 production route, configurations c4/native_c8, one prefill and one decode step per state dtype; cached builds. Directional screen only because the repair was uncommitted.
dirty_screen.note: Directional only. Retained performance evidence requires a clean repeated rerun.

decision: Keep the repair through the clean full packed quality gate and repeated A/B. The pre-repair c>N route is numerically rejected despite a passing global average; decode/isolation were sound, but binding prefill scopes failed.
